problems.quote: It will be free for everyone until the end of 2027.
problems.explanation: No claim says anything about pricing or availability of the NIST practices. The statement is invented.

problems.quote: It is the most capable system of its kind ever released.
problems.explanation: The claims contain no support for this superlative about PyTorch 2.15.

problems.quote: Today, anthropic says a new GSA agreement
problems.explanation: The story was published on 2026-10-27 and the edition date is 2026-11-13, so "Today" is wrong.

problems.quote: Anthropic introduces Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 as one model with two access tiers
problems.explanation: The claims name "Claude Fable" and "Claude Mythos 5.2". They give no version number for Fable, so "Fable 5.2" is unsupported. The summary repeats this as "Claude Fable 5.2".
